Finding F-011: potential underbilling on contract C-2007, SKU MFG-1005 (Servo motor unit), customer Crestline Tooling Co.

Root cause: PARTIAL_ESCALATION. Only some of the contractual anniversary escalations were applied in billing.

Contract basis: Clause A.1 (page 3) sets the base price at USD 488.25 per unit. Clause 4.2 (page 1) provides a 3.5% annual uplift effective January 1, 2024 and annually thereafter.
Calculation: USD 488.25 x (1 + 3.5%) [2024-01-01] x (1 + 3.5%) [2025-01-01] = USD 523.03.

Impact: 12 invoice lines, 2025-01-05 to 2025-12-05. Latest billed unit price USD 505.34 vs expected USD 523.03. Potential underbilling USD 21,210.31; estimated recoverable USD 21,210.31.
